type: Editorial review of one frame per beat plus timing/loudness analysis. Scores evaluate the creative; they are not measured campaign conversion rates.

Added an animated trend connector and moving cursor to the reports scene.

findings.Hook: The question Fila no caixa? and the POS illustration are visible at frame zero; the spoken question finishes inside the first three seconds.
findings.Readability: Large navy/purple headings, high-contrast burned captions and clear website/WhatsApp details. Essential text avoids lower overlays.
findings.Motion Quality: Eased 3D hero movement, drifting manual-work cards, moving flow dots, scanning line, staggered stock boxes, bar fills and an animated trend line.
findings.Brand Accuracy: Exact official Frenty logo, approved light palette and F-PDV terminology. Symbolic objects and native illustrations use the benefits supplied by the user. Free demonstration is stated in the supplied copy.
findings.Sound Sync: 120 BPM recovered from percussion RMS transients. All scene starts and important callout times land on 0.5-second beats. Captions follow generated word boundaries. Preview AAC measures -14.00 LUFS and -2.22 dBTP.
